notes.title: Patch 1.1.0.5
notes.notes:
This patch contains bug fixes.

[FIXED] Fatal error on Windows 11 upon launching the game.
[FIXED] Sometimes unable to spawn at the beginning of the match.
[FIXED] Sometimes sensitivity won't save.
[FIXED] Wrong amount being added after payment for premiums (affected players have been refunded the missing amount)

[IMPROVED] Menu buttons are now more responsive.

notes.title: NEW UPDATE 1.1.0.3
notes.notes:
This update aims to improve a few sections in LIGHTNING, including the Map Editor

Map Editor

 Curser not showing on the PUBLISH MAP page
 Extra meshes show up when loading a new map multiple times
 Button to hide visible function flags for screenshot purposes


Weapons

 New inspect animation for Karambit


Horde Mode

 Horde Mode: Mutants will get pushed back when under fire


Characters

 New character and voice in radio comms
 New voice for operators


Bug Fix

 Pressing the INTERACT button in any mode will bring up the Map Editor
 Rare crashes that happen in Plant-&-Defuse-based modes



All the best in 2024
Stay tuned for more intel.

notes.title: Improvement Patch 1.1.0.3
notes.notes:
[ADDED] New Voice Lines
[ADDED] New inspect animation for Karambit
[ADDED] Horde Mode: Mutants will get pushed back when under fire
[ADDED] Map Editor: Button to hide visible function flags for screenshot purposes
[FIXED] Pressing the INTERACT button in any mode will bring up the Map Editor
[FIXED] Few rare crashes that happen in Plant-&-Defuse-based modes
[FIXED] Map Editor: Curser not showing on the PUBLISH MAP page
[FIXED] Map Editor: Few extra meshes show up when loading a new Map
